breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided three conflicting time-integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler', 'IMEX Euler', and 'Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' and keeping the other two as valid options. The agent correctly identified the conflict, discarded the incorrect method, and selected one of the valid methods ('Strang splitting') to provide a single, unambiguous instruction. This successfully resolves the inconsistency in a manner consistent with the ground truth.
